name: Loricatosaurus
sum: Loricatosaurus is a Middle Jurassic stegosaur from the Oxford Clay of England, erected in 2008 for remains once assigned to Lexovisaurus.
holotype: NHMUK R3167, a partial skeleton with cervical, dorsal and caudal vertebrae, forelimb and hindlimb bones, pelvic parts and armour plates — Oxford Clay Formation, Peterborough, England.
material: Known from two partial skeletons; the second, from Normandy, France, was referred in 1985 and later reassigned.
biology: Stegosaur with armour plates and spines; the sources give no behavioural data.
author: Maidment et al. 2008

sources.text: Maidment, Susannah C.R. 2008. Systematics and phylogeny of Stegosauria (Dinosauria: Ornithischia). Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 6(4): 1. doi:10.1017/S1477201908002459
